description:
Job Title: Affiliate Marketer
Company: 3 Dragons Brewing

Location: Remote

About 3 Dragons Brewing: 3 Dragons Brewing is a rapidly growing botanical soda manufacturing facility specializing in Kava and botanical sodas. We pride ourselves on creating unique, high-quality beverages that stand out in the market. Our sodas are crafted using whole leaf botanicals, allowing us to offer three distinct strains: energizing white, relaxing red, and euphoric green. Our dedication to quality and innovation has earned us a loyal following, and we are excited to expand our reach even further.

Job Description: As an Affiliate Marketer for 3 Dragons Brewing, you will play a pivotal role in promoting our brand and products to a broader audience. You will be responsible for generating sales through your unique affiliate code, with the opportunity to earn a 10% commission on every sale you drive. This role is perfect for someone passionate about health, wellness, and botanical beverages, who is eager to share our products with their network and beyond.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Promote 3 Dragons Brewing's line of botanical sodas, focusing on their unique benefits and high-quality ingredients.
  • Share your unique affiliate code across various platforms, including social media, blogs, email newsletters, and more.
  • Develop and execute creative marketing strategies to reach potential customers.
  • Track and report on sales performance and commission earnings.
  • Stay updated on product offerings, promotions, and company news to effectively communicate with your audience.
  • Collaborate with the 3 Dragons Brewing team to refine marketing tactics and explore new opportunities for growth.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in affiliate marketing or a strong understanding of online marketing strategies is preferred
  • A passion for health, wellness, and natural products.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in using social media platforms and other online marketing tools.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and manage your own marketing efforts.
  • A network of followers, subscribers, or customers interested in health and wellness is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • A 10% commission on all sales generated through your affiliate code.
  • The opportunity to be part of a growing company with a unique and high-quality product line.
  • Access to exclusive promotions, discounts, and insider information on new product releases.
  • Ongoing support and resources to help you succeed as an affiliate marketer.
  • The chance to become a part of the "Dragon Family" and contribute to the growth of a brand you believe in.

How to Apply: If you’re passionate about health and wellness and excited about the opportunity to promote a truly unique product, we’d love to hear from you! To apply, please submit the aplication form. Resumes can also be emailed to Joe@3dragonsbrewing.com

Join us in spreading the word about 3 Dragons Brewing, and let's grow together
